---

Classical regression and generalized linear models represent a special case of multilevel modeling in which there is no group-level model-in Bayesian terms, no prior information.
- For the classical regression model, $y_i = X_i\beta + \varepsilon_i$ , with independent errors $\varepsilon_i \sim N(0, \sigma^2)$, the corresponding prior distribution is a uniform distribution on the entire range $\infty, -\infty$
